sections.Profile:
"South Pacific" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in October 1964.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Aviation, Boats, Two player, Travel, Good Times, Dancing, Original Theme, Water, Music
